Hours after Trump-Putin diesel deal, Ukraine strikes Russian fuel site
Hours after US President Donald Trump announced a deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin to ease diesel sanctions, a Ukrainian drone strike set a fuel facility in Russia’s Rostov region ablaze. The governor says more than 50 drones were intercepted, with no injuries.
